inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have documentation showing a recent fire inspection was conducted by the local Fire Marshal. The last documented fire inspection the operation had on file was from 7/2/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation did not have proof showing that minimum standards training had been obtained by the CEO of the operation within the sixty days of the start of the probation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation did not have proof showing that minimum standards training had been obtained by the governing body and persons left in charge within the sixty days of the start of the probation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: The operation did not have documentation showing a recent fire inspection was conducted by the local Fire Marshal. The last documented fire inspection the operation had on file was from 7/2/2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Franchise Tax Delinquent: The operation failed to maintain an active franchise tax status, and as a result, the entity?s franchise tax   status has been forfeited.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Franchise Tax Delinquent (26 TAC §745.247)

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: During the follow up inspection, the operation provided documentation showing that monthly meetings between the CEO and the director have occurred. However, the operation did not have proof showing that minimum standards training had been obtained by the governing body and persons left in charge within the sixty days of the start of the probation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: A substitute caregiver counted in ratio, the director and one caregiver were missing current proof of pediatric CPR training at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: A 16 month old infant was not current on their immunizations and was missing the third doses of the DTaP and PCV vaccines.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: At the time of the inspection, the operation had not filled out documentation showing that a monthly meeting between the CEO and director had occurred by 4/24/2026.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: A substitute caregiver counted in ratio, the director and one caregiver were missing proof of current pediatric first aid training at the time of the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children: During the inspection, one caregiver was with the 11 children who were in care; the ages of the children were 17 months, 2 years, 2 years, 2 years, 3 years, 3 years, 3 years, 3 years, 3 years, 4 years and 4 years.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 12 or Fewer Children (26 TAC §746.1701)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: One of the ten children records reviewed was missing an immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: One caregiver had completed 17.5 hours of required 24 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights: The parent handbook was missing information about Parent Rights. This was corrected at inspection when the director added the parent rights information into the handbook.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Parent Rights (26 TAC §746.501(a)(20))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The operation has not conducted monthly checks of the fire extinguishers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Requirements during probation: The operation has not been complying with the following conditions for the probation: the director has not been documenting information obtained during walk throughs of the center twice daily; the attendance sheets do not contain all the required information stated in the probation conditions; the Governing Body has not developed and submitted  a plan to CCR guaranteeing that ratios are always maintained; the operation has not implemented their daily checklist for indoor and outdoor safety checks to be completed before children occupy any space.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements during probation (26 TAC §745.8641)

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: The operation has not conducted monthly checks of the carbon monoxide detector.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: In the infant room, there was more than an 18-month difference between the youngest infant and oldest toddler.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: In the outdoor play area, the grass and weeds exceeded 12 inches in height. A double gate and a spot in the fence in the outdoor play area had gaps large enough for children to go through the gate and fence. In the infant room, foam was exposed on the diaper changing mat; the operation put duct tape over the exposed foam during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Safe Sleeping Deficiency: The operation did not notify parents of all enrolled children of a safe sleep deficiency which was cited on 12/15/25 by 12/20/25.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Safe Sleeping Deficiency (26 TAC §746.309(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Complying with Laws and Rules: The owner has not followed policy in regard to the Plan of Action. The building and grounds checklists were not completed for the month of November and one week in October. Two caregivers did not have updated training, according to the Plan of Action.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Complying with Laws and Rules (26 TAC §746.201(9))

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: The director did not ensure that the operation operated in compliance when a person was left in charge did not have knowledge of where child files were kept.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Authority: During an inspection, the person in charge did not have access to the personnel files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Authority (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Authority: During an inspection, the person in charge did not ensure that ratios were maintained and that safe sleep practices were being followed. The person in charge also did not have access to the records required for the plan of action review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Has Authority (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records: During an inspection, training records were not available for review by CCR staff.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Personnel and Training Records (26 TAC §746.801(3))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During an inspection, the infant room was observed to have 7 infants in care with 1 caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: During an inspection, an infant was observed to be napping in a crib with a crib sheet that was loose.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: During an inspection, the infant room with a specified age group of 0-12 months had 6 children in care with 1 caregiver. Minimum standards states that this group should only have 4 children with 1 caregiver. During the inspection, 2 of the children were moved to another classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: At the time of inspection, 3 of the 5 the infant seats at the feeding table did not have straps present. The children were not observed strapped in the chairs during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Time Period of Training: At the time of inspection, a caregiver that has been employed at the facility since December 2023 did not any record of the previous years trainings. The training certificates had been discarded prior to the inspection date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Time Period of Training (26 TAC §746.1313)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: During the inspection time the owner/director advised that they have not reviewed the minimum standards in quite some times and is not familiar with current minimum standards and safety requirements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play - 13 Months to Toddler and Pre K: This standard was tasked over for this investigation and inspection and found to be deficient. It was determined during the investigation that the children in care only go outdoors for play time approximately 10-15 minutes throughout the day.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Outdoor Play - 13 Months to Toddler and Pre K (26 TAC §746.2206(1)(B))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: This standard was tasked over for this investigation and found to be deficient. It was determined that a caregiver was allowed to be present in a classroom with a group of children prior to their background check eligibility being received. The caregiver was present at the facility on 9/12/25, eligibility notification wasn't received until 9/13/25. At the time of inspection, the caregiver was no longer employed or present at the facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age: This standard was tasked over for this investigation and found to be deficient. It was determined during this investigation and inspection that a 2-year-old child in care was able to climb out and almost fall from their crib during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Individual Cot, Bed, or Mat for Each Walking Child Through 4 Years of Age (26 TAC §746.4503(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervised Naptime Daily: This standard was tasked over for this investigation and found to be deficient. It was determined during the investigation, via recorded video footage, that two classes were not supervised by an adult while the children were asleep during naptime. Only the sleeping children were present in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervised Naptime Daily (26 TAC §746.2901)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: The brownish red play structure has not received any repairs and some of the bottom wooden planks are lifting from the structure. Some screws are protruding on the structure and can be an entanglement hazards as well. Provider was advised to rope off the structures until further notice.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: No updates have been made to the loose fill in the playground area.  The rubber mulch in the playground area was very low at the time of inspection, as grass had grown up in the area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director did not have documentation to account for the required 30 hours of annual training from the previous full year available for review. The director is currently missing 24 hours from the previous year. May 2024 - May 2025 is the training year. The director has scheduled classes to complete additional trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: At the time of arrival for the investigation inspection, I observed a caregiver left in charge of one of the classes run back to their classroom as I appeared at the door. The classroom was left unsupervised for an unknown amount of time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: This standard was tasked over for this investigation and found to be deficient. At the time of inspection, the infants class had a total of 6 children and one caregiver present. The two youngest children being 7 months of age and the oldest being 22 months.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Pest Extermination: This standard was tasked over for this investigation and found to be deficient. It was determined during the time of the investigation inspection that the provider had not scheduled a pest control appointment since the last visit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pest Extermination (26 TAC §746.3427)

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: As of today the operation has yet to conduct a lock down drill while the children are in care. Latches have been added to some classrooms for safety during the lock downs and caregivers have been instructed on what the drills are for, but a physical drill has not been conducted.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director did not have documentation to account for the required 30 hours of annual training from the previous full year available for review. The director has scheduled classes to complete additional trainings.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: The brownish red play structure had openings and exposed nails at the time of the inspection. Some of the large nails in the border of the playground areas were also lifted in the smaller playground area. Some screws are protruding on the structure and can be an entanglement hazards as well.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: No updates have been made to the loose fill in the playground area.  The rubber mulch in the playground area was very low at the time of inspection, as grass had grown up in the area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Pest Extermination: This standard was tasked over for this investigation and found to be deficient. A live bug and dead bug were observed in the diaper changing table in the 2's classroom. It was determined that pest control had not been present in the center since the previous year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pest Extermination (26 TAC §746.3427)

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: At the time of inspection it was determined that no lock down drill had ever been conducted with the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: At the time of inspection a caregiver with a pending background check status was present and unsupervised with a group of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: At the time of inspection, three children did not have their most current immunizations records, according to their current age, on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: At the time of inspection, four children did not have a health statement on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: At the time of inspection, some of the staff files were not properly prepared with the required documents and/or were not present to review fully.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The rubber mulch in the playground area was very low at the time of inspection, as grass had grown up in the area.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: One infant in care did not have their infant feeding instruction form present and up to date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director did not have documentation to account for the required 30 hours of annual training from the previous full year available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points: The brownish red play structure had openings and exposed nails at the time of the inspections. Some of the large nails in the border of the playground areas were also lifted at this time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Active Play Equipment - No Pinch, Crush, or Shear Points (26 TAC §746.4601(7))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: At the time of the inspection, neither of the staff or management had current CPR/First Aid certification on file for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System: The operation did not have a carbon monoxide detector present in the center at the time of inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child-Care Center Must be Equipped with a Working Carbon Monoxide (CO) Detection System (26 TAC §746.5531)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation by the Department of Family and Protective Services and was found to be deficient. The director did not ensure staff followed proper procedures and failed to respond appropriately to parent concerns. There was insufficient oversight of caregiver conduct and incident handling, which demonstrated a lack of compliance with the minimum standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation by the Department of Family and Protective Services and was found to be deficient. The operation failed to notify Licensing within the required 48-hour timeframe after a potential incident involving a child injury.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: AP Parental Notification of Deficiency as described in 746.309 within 5 Days: The operation was cited on 11/18/2024 for a safe sleep deficiency. The operation has not notified the parents of the deficiency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Parental Notification of Deficiency as described in 746.309 within 5 Days (26 TAC §746.311(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: This standard was found to be deficient due to the presence of a wasp nest on teh playground structure posing a safety hazard.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Waterproof, Washable Mattress: This standard was found to be deficient due to the crib mattress having significant tears in the cover, exposing the foam padding underneath which poses potential safety concerns. This was correct as the caregiver was asked to remove the mattress from the crib.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Waterproof, Washable Mattress (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: This standard was found to be deficient. Evidence indicates disciplinary practices that exceeded acceptable guidelines, including excessive timeouts and loud verbal reprimands. The evidence confirmed that children were scared due to yelling and angry responses from the director when they did not listen. This created an intimidating environment, which is inconsistent with the minimum standards for positive discipline and guidance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance: This standard was found to be deficient. The daily operations of the center did not align with required standards. Disciplinary methods, such as loud verbal reprimands and yelling, were reported as intimidating and inappropriate. Oversight and enforcement of positive guidance practices were inadequate, contributing to a negative environment for the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Responsibilities - Operate in Compliance (26 TAC §746.1003(1))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation by the Department of Family and Protective Services and was found to be deficient as the Director did not provide incident reports to the parents of a child who sustained a burn injury. This is a violation of the requirement to notify parents of less serious injuries, including those requiring first-aid treatment, at the time of pick-up. Failure to communicate such incidents compromises transparency and the parents' ability to appropriately respond to their child?s needs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation by the Department of Family and Protective Services and was found to be deficient as the victim child, did not have an enrollment folder on file. The lack of documentation demonstrates non-compliance with the requirement to maintain accurate and complete records for all children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation by the Department of Family and Protective Services and was found to be deficient as personnel files for caregiver was missing required training records. This deficiency indicates the operation failed to ensure proper documentation of caregiver qualifications and training compliance.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib: This standard was evaluated as part of an investigation by the Department of Family and Protective Services and was found to be deficient as three children were observed sleeping in cribs without mattresses. A caregiver reported that the Director had removed the mattresses. This violates the requirement that all cribs must have a firm, flat mattress that snugly fits the sides of the crib and is specifically designed for use with the crib model number. The absence of mattresses compromises the safety and well-being of children and does not meet the required safety standards for cribs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting, Firm, Flat Mattress Designed for Use in Crib (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months: This standard was found to be deficient as the operation did not have a current fire inspection during the walkthrough.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records: This standard was found to be deficient as the operation failed to provide any current documentation of a playground checklist.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Playground Maintenance Records (26 TAC §746.801(8))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: This standard was found to be deficient as the operation failed to provide current infant feeding forms for 5 children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: This standard was found to be deficient after the operation's school playground was observed to have a board with exposed nails and cabinets needing repair, with these hazardous areas being accessible to the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Required Postings-Licensing notices with instructions to post: This standard was found to be deficient as the operation did not have an up-to-date employee list.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Postings-Licensing notices with instructions to post (26 TAC §746.401(11))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation did not report the number of employees who left the operation in 2023 to CCR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets: This standard was found to be deficient after most of  sheets in the cribs were loose.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §746.2409(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: This standard was found to be deficient after 2 caregivers do not have their current CPR training in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: This standard was found to be deficient after the operation did not conduct a fire drill last month.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Gudie to first aid and emergency care: This standard was found to be incomplete after their First Aid Kit was missing their guide to first aid and emergency care .
occurrences.violation_type_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Gudie to first aid and emergency care (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: This standard was found to be deficient after children were observed in feeding chairs without straps.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: This standard was found to be deficient after a caregiver did not meet the required 24 hours of annual training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months: This standard was found to be deficient after 3 staff did not have their required  children younger than 24 months of age, one hour of that caregiver s pre-service training regarding (1)Recognizing and preventing shaken baby syndrome and abusive head trauma   (2)Understanding and using safe sleep practices and preventing sudden infant death syndrome (SIDS) (3)Understanding early childhood brain development
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pre-service Training for Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months (26 TAC §746.1305(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: An individual was observed to be in the classroom without a cleared background check on July 14, 2023.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: The operation allowed 1 individual to be present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the person's eligibility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
